name: Image-based Participating Media Simulation
definition: An image-based method that adds perceptually plausible participating media effects (fog, smoke) to a single, clean high dynamic range (HDR) image without requiring 3D scene knowledge, overcoming the underconstrained nature of the problem with minimal user input.
summary: Image-based Participating Media Simulation adds fog or smoke to a single HDR image using depth estimation and image processing, avoiding the need for 3D geometry or physical light transport simulation.
